prompt: Create ONE production sprite atlas for a Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup style pixel-art game: 24 evenly spaced square cells, exactly 8 columns and 3 rows, transparent background. 22 complete worship altar structures, last two cells empty. Each altar must be a DIFFERENT physical structure with its OWN unique base silhouette and material. NO repeated stone pedestal. No existing game altar behind it.
